mil3.6.9:1.2: “Sir Nagasena, you say ‘this is transmigration’—what is that transmigration”?
mil3.6.9:1.3: “Here, Great King, born, he dies right here, and dying here he is reborn elsewhere; born, he dies right there, and dying there he is reborn elsewhere. Thus, Great King, transmigration is”.
mil3.6.9:1.5: “Suppose, Great King, that a certain man chewed a ripe mango and planted its stone; then a great mango tree grew up and bore fruit, and then that man chewed a ripe mango from it as well and planted its stone, and from that too a great mango tree grew up and bore fruit. In the same way, the end of those trees is not known;
mil3.6.9:1.6: Even so, Great King, here born, he dies right here, and dying here he is reborn elsewhere; born, he dies right there, and dying there he is reborn elsewhere. Thus, Great King, transmigration is”.
